context: Tests whether the final report distinguishes builder proof from independent review and includes the task sources, redacted command, exact clean result, provider policy, and absence of findings.

checklist.name: Sources named
checklist.description: closeout.md names the user request and APP-42 as authoritative task sources

checklist.name: Builder proof named
checklist.description: The report separately records branch tests and browser smoke as builder evidence

checklist.name: Review command recorded
checklist.description: The report records the branch review command or its meaningful flags with the prompt value redacted

checklist.name: Claude provider recorded
checklist.description: The report identifies Claude as the single reviewer

checklist.name: Clean exit recorded
checklist.description: The report states exit 0 and status clean

checklist.name: No findings recorded
checklist.description: The report explicitly states that the valid review contained no findings

checklist.name: Attempt evidence recorded
checklist.description: The report mentions the one valid attempt

checklist.name: Web state recorded
checklist.description: The report records that web access was off

checklist.name: No ship overclaim
checklist.description: The report presents a clean independent closeout without claiming consensus, universal correctness, or an autonomous ship decision
